description.zh: 成员ID列表，多个成员ID以半角逗号（,）分隔。如何获取成员ID，请参见[ListMembers](~~449135~~)。
description.en: The list of member IDs. Separate multiple member IDs with commas (,). You can call [ListMembers](~~449135~~) to obtain the member ID.

description.zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。
description.en: The workspace ID. You can call [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) to obtain the workspace ID.
